description.value: Mr. Dumpling (包好吃) is a Chinese fast food counter in Richmond, BC serving dumplings from a unit inside a larger commercial complex on Westminster Highway. Richmond is one of Canada's premier destinations for authentic Chinese cuisine, and this spot sits within that rich culinary corridor. A touring cyclist looking for a quick, filling bite after riding the flat dyke trails of the Fraser delta would find it a practical and flavourful stop.
